remarks: Here it is...this updated 2Br, 2BA loft townhouse has it all! Commuters delight. Conveniently close to Route 7, I-95, train station. Easy access to shopping, dining and entertainment. Nature paradise. 2 decks provide stunning views of a serene pond, ideal for outdoor dining, morning coffee, or simply unwinding after a long day. Updated kitchen with high end finishes featuring cherry cabinets, stainless steel appliances, glass backsplash. Enjoy an open floor plan with a cozy fireplace, perfect for relaxing evenings and entertaining guests. Versatile loft space. The loft area can serve as a home office, third bedroom, or a creative studio. Attached heated garage for secure parking, plenty of additional parking in the complex. Lots of storage. Even has a large crawl space (450 sq. ft.) with cedar closets and can be your wine cellar. 2 Pets are welcome in this community. Home will be sold to the highest bidder.
